messages:
sara_support: Customer reported tool invoke failing with JSON schema validation when calling the order-processor function. Error from our gateway: `schema_validation_error` and mentions additionalProperties + type mismatch. Repro steps attached. Escalating — customer is blocked (billing job).

leo_engineer: Can you drop the exact API payload + gateway logs? Tagging @maya_sre in case it's an input-coercion/ingress issue.

sara_support: Pasting the curl we used to repro and the gateway error. Customer payload originally sent from their Node SDK.

sara_support: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"function":"order-processor","args":{"order_id":"12345","items":[{"sku":"WIDGET-A","qty":"2"}],"customer_session":{"id":"sess_abc","metadata":{}}}}'
```

sara_support: Gateway log excerpt: 
```
2026-03-15T14:02:10Z ERROR validation "schema_validation_error" path: args.items[0].qty - expected integer but got string
2026-03-15T14:02:10Z ERROR validation additionalProperties not allowed: 'customer_session' at path: args
```

maya_sre: Two issues here: 1) items[0].qty is a string - schema expects integer. 2) customer_session is an extra object not in the declared function schema (additionalProperties false). Both will trigger validation reject. Do we have the function schema for order-processor loaded?

leo_engineer: I pulled the function manifest we onboarded:
```json
{"name":"order-processor","schema":{"type":"object","required":["order_id","items"],"properties":{"order_id":{"type":"integer"},"items":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","required":["sku","qty"],"properties":{"sku":{"type":"string"},"qty":{"type":"integer"}}}}},"additionalProperties":false}}
```

sara_support: Customer says they always pass order_id and qty as strings from their frontend (JS), and the SDK used to coerce ints but a recent SDK bump stopped coercion. They upgraded last week.

nate_support: Customer_jane confirmed: "after upgrading to @redwood/sdk-js v4.2.0 we started getting validation errors; v4.1.1 accepted the same payload".

leo_engineer: That explains noncanonical types. Two parallel remediation paths: 1) short-term: support can instruct customer to coerce types before calling (quick fix). 2) longer-term: consider adding lenient coercion/compat-mode in runtime for a transition window or update SDK to restore coercion. Also need to handle additionalProperties — either accept a limited set of session fields or document that session must be under args.meta (or removed).

maya_sre: For immediate unblock, we can apply a routing shim on our ingress that will coerce numeric-like strings to integers for keys that are expected ints per manifest and strip whitelisted extra keys (e.g., customer_session -> move to args.meta.session). This needs eng sign-off; low-risk patch.

leo_engineer: Agree. I'll open an eng ticket with repro and suggested patch. Assigning to eng-inference. Action items: create patch + feature flag off by default. Customer wants fast patch — can we do temporary workaround in prod for this single customer?

sara_support: Customer_jane: "we can flip to v4.1.1 but need a permanent path forward; our pipelines expect no breaks". They volunteered a copy of their payload and are ok with a temporary shim.

ops-bot: Routing to #eng-inference and creating incident 2026-03-15-IS-482 with severity: high.

leo_engineer: Created GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ingress/issues/1423 (title: accept-numeric-strings-and-handle-session-additionalprop). Added repro, payload, logs from this thread.

maya_sre: For the ticket, include the manifest JSON above, the customer's payload, and this repro curl. Suggested change: on validation path, run a pre-processor that: (a) attempts to coerce strings to integer/number when schema type is integer/number and value matches ^\\d+$ or ^\\d+\\.\\d+$; (b) when additionalProperties is false, if an extra key matches a known allowed shim list (customer_session -> args.meta.session), move it instead of rejecting. Flagged behind `--compat-mode` toggle.

nate_support: I've notified the customer that eng is working on a temporary shim and provided a deterministic workaround (coerce types + remove customer_session) in their code while we patch. Customer marked as "needs follow-up".

leo_engineer: Next steps for eng: quick patch + test on staging (validate with the customer's payload), then enable for that customer in prod behind a flag, monitor errors for 24h, then schedule SDK fix to reintroduce explicit coercion or better versioning docs.

sara_support: Thanks. If anyone from eng wants the raw payload or more logs I can paste them here or DM. :white_check_mark:

customer_jane: Confirmed we can test staging once it's ready. We'll hold off downgrading for now and wait for the shim.

leo_engineer: I'll post updates in this thread and close when the shim is live and customer verifies.

ops-bot: Incident 2026-03-15-IS-482 updated: state -> in_progress, owner -> leo_engineer
